vins.title: VINs
vins.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Numbers, one per item (up to 1,000 per run). Example: 1HGCM82633A004352

includeRecalls.title: Include safety recalls
includeRecalls.description: Recall campaigns for this make, model and year (NHTSA). Note: this lists campaigns that apply to the model year, it cannot say whether this particular car has already been repaired.

includeComplaints.title: Include owner complaints
includeComplaints.description: Count of owner complaints filed with NHTSA for this make, model and year, the most affected components, and the most recent complaints.

includeRatings.title: Include crash-test ratings
includeRatings.description: NHTSA 5-star safety ratings (overall, front, side, rollover) when the vehicle was rated.

maxComplaintsPerVehicle.title: Recent complaints to return per vehicle
maxComplaintsPerVehicle.description: How many of the most recent complaint records to include (the total count is always included). Set 0 for counts only.
